# SubbieBill

> SubbieBill is a web app for people who work on an ABN in Australia (subcontractors, tradies, cleaners, drivers, designers, carers, tutors and other sole traders). You choose how you are paid (by the hour, by the day, a fixed amount for the week/fortnight/month, or a fixed price for a job) and it creates a professional PDF invoice with your ABN, BSB and account number, the work, the rate or price and the total in AUD, including GST (10%) when you are registered for GST.

Website: https://subbiebill.com/
Works in any browser, on phone or computer. Nothing to install. Interface in English, French, Spanish, Italian and Portuguese; invoices are always in English.

## What it does

- 4 ways to bill: by the hour, by the day, fixed amount for the period, fixed price for a job
- By the hour: turns daily start and finish times into hours, including unpaid breaks, overtime rates and public holiday rates
- By the day: tap the days worked, enter the day rate; one line per day on the invoice
- Fixed amount or fixed price: one line with the period or job dates, the description and the amount, no hours shown
- Weekly, fortnightly or monthly invoices
- "Tax invoice" with GST shown separately when the user is registered for GST, plain "Invoice" with "No GST has been charged" when not
- Expense lines (fuel, materials, tolls) on the invoice
- Unique invoice numbers, due dates, client ABN
- Saved clients, work locations and drafts
- Premium: clean invoices without the verification code, history of every invoice with yearly totals, re-download any invoice, email invoices to the client, paid / overdue tracking

## Pricing (AUD)

- Free: 3 finished invoices with every tool, kept in the History, no card needed. Free invoices carry a small verification code (QR) at the bottom; anyone with it can check the invoice at https://subbiebill.com/v
- Premium: $4.99 a month or $39 a year, cancel anytime. Online payment is open now (secure checkout by Stripe)

## Referral program

- Share your link: a friend who signs up with it gets 1 extra free invoice; when they take Premium you get 1 month of Premium (or A$4.99 off if you already pay), 14 days after their first payment, up to 12 times

## What it is not

SubbieBill is not accounting software: no bank reconciliation, BAS lodgement or payroll. It is not tax advice.

## How to use it (button by button)

- [Illustrated step-by-step help](https://subbiebill.com/help.html): every screen with the button to tap highlighted. Also in [French](https://subbiebill.com/help-fr.html), [Spanish](https://subbiebill.com/help-es.html), [Italian](https://subbiebill.com/help-it.html), [Portuguese](https://subbiebill.com/help-pt.html)
- [Full step list with exact button names in all 5 languages](https://subbiebill.com/llms-full.txt)
- Short version: tap "Create my first invoice", sign up with email and password, enter the 6-digit code from the email, add your name, ABN, BSB, account number and GST status, type your client, choose how you are paid ("By the hour", "By the day", "Fixed weekly" or "Fixed price"); by the hour: set your hourly rate, enter Monday's start and finish then "Copy Monday to Tue → Fri"; by the day: enter the day rate and tap the days worked; fixed: type the amount, tap "Finish invoice", then "Finish and download PDF".
